title: Deep Sets
relevance: Permutation-invariant representation of variable-size charging-session sets.

title: Set Transformer: A Framework for Attention-based Permutation-Invariant Neural Networks
relevance: Attention-based modeling of interactions within future charging-session sets.

title: The Neural Hawkes Process: A Neurally Self-Modulating Multivariate Point Process
relevance: Event-time modeling for stochastic vehicle arrivals and marked charging sessions.

title: Intensity-Free Learning of Temporal Point Processes
relevance: Flexible event-time density modeling without explicit intensity integration.

title: Multivariate Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting via Conditioned Normalizing Flows
relevance: Joint scenario generation with explicit likelihood for correlated charging variables.

title: Task-based End-to-end Model Learning in Stochastic Optimization
relevance: Foundational predict-then-optimize training objective for downstream charging dispatch.

title: OptNet: Differentiable Optimization as a Layer in Neural Networks
relevance: Embedding quadratic programs in forecasting networks.

title: Differentiable Convex Optimization Layers
relevance: General convex optimization layers for coherent scenarios or decision feedback.

title: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
relevance: Online coverage control when charging behavior changes over time.

title: In Search of Lost Domain Generalization
relevance: Strong baselines and evaluation discipline for cross-station/cross-city generalization.

title: Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data
relevance: FedAvg baseline; necessary but insufficient for non-IID charging clients.

title: Federated Optimization in Heterogeneous Networks
relevance: FedProx baseline for system and statistical heterogeneity.

title: Personalized Federated Learning with Moreau Envelopes
relevance: Personalization baseline for heterogeneous charging stations or operators.

title: Time-Series Forecasting for Out-of-Distribution Generalization Using Invariant Learning
relevance: FOIL shows model-agnostic invariant learning and inferred environments for OOD TSF; generic use alone is not EV novelty.

title: Learning Pattern-Specific Experts for Time Series Forecasting Under Patch-level Distribution Shift
relevance: TFPS occupies dynamic pattern clustering and specialized experts under segment-level distribution shifts.

title: Model-Agnostic Online Certificate-Driven Calibration for Time Series Forecasting Under Distribution Shift
relevance: Finite-sample martingale certificates and a gated residual head with reversion to the backbone narrow the novelty of ordinary online calibration/fallback.

title: KMM-CP: Practical Conformal Prediction under Covariate Shift via Selective Kernel Mean Matching
relevance: Support-overlap-aware selective conformal correction is a direct methodological neighbor for abstaining on unsupported charging stations.

title: Conformalized Adaptive Forecasting of Heterogeneous Trajectories
relevance: Provides entire-path coverage rather than marginal per-step intervals; relevant for day-ahead charging curves.

title: Adaptive Conformal Inference for Multi-Step Ahead Time-Series Forecasting Online
relevance: Establishes per-horizon and overall online coverage adaptation for multi-step forecasts.

title: Sequential Predictive Conformal Inference for Time Series
relevance: Baseline for time-dependent residual calibration; ordinary SPCI application cannot be the main innovation.

title: FLIPR: FLexible and Interpretable Prediction Regions for Time Series
relevance: Provides balanced joint regions across horizons, directly relevant to trajectory-level charging-power guarantees.

title: Probabilistic Reconciliation of Mixed-Type Hierarchical Time Series
relevance: Enables coherent joint distributions for counts and continuous quantities, useful for arrival–occupancy–energy hierarchies.

title: In-Context Fine-Tuning for Time-Series Foundation Models
relevance: Shows inference-time adaptation using related time-series examples; a foundation model plus examples is not by itself novel.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models for Time Series Forecasting
relevance: Direct neighbor for analog-station retrieval and generative forecasting; EV novelty needs domain support semantics and risk control.

title: UniTS: A Unified Multi-Task Time Series Model
relevance: Foundation-model baseline for zero/few-shot and multi-task forecasting.

title: FedMixer: Heterogeneity-Resilient Federated Learning for Time Series Forecasting
venue: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
relevance: Adaptive client clustering, heterogeneous cluster models and mutual distillation already occupy ordinary heterogeneous-model FL for TSF.

title: Tackling Data Heterogeneity in Federated Time Series Forecasting
relevance: Fed-TREND shows synthetic-data knowledge carriers and model-agnostic integration for heterogeneous federated TSF.

title: FedProC: A Benchmarking Framework for Federated Time-Series Forecasting
relevance: Provides a reproducible benchmark platform for traditional and personalized federated TSF; should be considered before building a bespoke stack.

title: Valid and Efficient Uncertainty Quantification for Federated Joint Shift
relevance: FCPJS gives privacy-preserving global score sketches and importance-weighted client calibration under joint shift; federated calibration alone is crowded.

title: Non-clairvoyant Scheduling with Partial Predictions
relevance: Introduces robustness, consistency and smoothness criteria for schedules using predictions without guarantees; useful for safe charging dispatch.

title: Conformal Prediction in The Loop: A Feedback-Based Uncertainty Model for Trajectory Optimization
relevance: Shows calibration and trajectory optimization can be coupled through feedback; generic CP-in-the-loop is not an empty space.

title: DDN: Dual-domain Dynamic Normalization for Non-stationary Time Series Forecasting
relevance: Strong plug-in baseline for nonstationary charging load; normalization alone is not a research direction.

title: TimeXer: Empowering Transformers for Time Series Forecasting with Exogenous Variables
relevance: Baseline for weather, price, POI and contextual variables; adding exogenous features through attention is already standard.

title: Slimming the Fat-Tail: Morphing-Flow for Adaptive Time Series Modeling
relevance: Direct generic baseline for heavy-tailed charging peaks under drift; tail-aware EV work must add calibrated exceedance risk and strict station/city OOD semantics.

title: Selective Learning for Deep Time Series Forecasting
relevance: Shows that filtering uncertain/anomalous timesteps during training is already a generic TSF technique; data-quality filtering alone is not an EV novelty.

title: Neural MJD: Neural Non-Stationary Merton Jump Diffusion for Time Series Prediction
relevance: Provides an explicit diffusion-plus-jump process neighbor for abrupt charging-demand peaks; an EV contribution must focus on tail calibration, peak timing and operational exceedance risk.

title: Predictive inference for time series: why is split conformal effective despite temporal dependence?
relevance: Clarifies coverage loss under stationary beta-mixing dependence; ordinary split conformal on charging time series cannot be claimed as new or automatically valid.

title: Winner-takes-all for Multivariate Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
relevance: Lightweight multi-future generation is established generically; charging scenarios need physical/service coherence, tail calibration or decision value to differentiate.

title: SynTSBench: Rethinking Temporal Pattern Learning in Deep Learning Models for Time Series
relevance: Supports capability-driven model selection and controlled corruption tests before proposing a new architecture for charging data.

title: Score-Based Diffusion Priors for Adaptive Conformal Inference under Distribution Shift
relevance: Further crowds generic adaptive conformal calibration under shift; EV novelty must come from support semantics, trajectory/tail risk and operational fallback.

title: Plug-in Performative Optimization
theme: performative optimization with misspecified feedback models
relevance: Provides a formal basis for using imperfect action-to-distribution response models; EV work must add response identification and grid-safe deployment.

title: Two-timescale Derivative Free Optimization for Performative Prediction with Markovian Data
relevance: Models sequential state-dependent feedback when deployed charging actions alter future observations.

title: Distributionally Robust Performative Optimization
theme: robust optimization under ambiguous decision-dependent distributions
relevance: Supports stress-testing misspecified behavioral response maps instead of treating a simulated response function as truth.

title: Performative Prediction with Bandit Feedback: Learning through Reparameterization
relevance: Relevant when charging operators observe only aggregate outcomes after interventions and cannot access gradients or a known distribution map.
